title: Flux of an Incompressible (Solenoidal) Vector Field
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Show that the outward flux of F = <y, z, x> through any closed surface S is zero.

steps.title: Compute Divergence
steps.mathExpression: \nabla \cdot \mathbf{F} = \frac{\partial y}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial x}{\partial z} = 0 + 0 + 0 = 0

steps.title: Apply Divergence Theorem
steps.explanation: The integral of zero over any solid volume is zero.
steps.why: Confirming vanishing of closed surface flux.
